reply_text:
I replied in the #coastal-team thread: Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on 3-Nov-2025.

That date comes from two places. Moss's Coastal digest of 2-Nov-2025 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow". Bettina's own recap note of 8-Dec-2025 also gives 3-Nov-2025 as the official handoff.

I also gave her the later dates from that recap note. She kept running the account day to day until 21-Nov-2025, and Kwame fully took over on 22-Nov-2025. That is in case her coverage tracker wants the takeover date rather than the official one.

I wrote the dates in her preferred day-Mon-year format.
